name: Harriss Roofing Inc
tagline: Family-owned roofing in Glen Burnie for over 35 years
meta_description: Family-owned roofing, siding, gutters and skylights in Glen Burnie, MD for over 35 years. MHIC #14129. 70 Google reviews, 4.9 stars. Call 410-760-7400.
headline: Residential and commercial roofing in Glen Burnie and Anne Arundel County.
subhead: Family owned and operated, licensed, bonded and insured, serving Anne Arundel County and surrounding areas for over 35 years. Rated 4.9 from 70 Google reviews.
services_lead: Roof repairs and full replacements, plus the siding, gutters and skylights that go with them, with a free in-depth estimate.

services.name: Roof repair
services.blurb: Repairs on all roof types: shingles, slate, leaks, flashing, ridge vents, chimneys and flat roofs, with a free in-depth estimate.

services.name: Residential roofing
services.blurb: Asphalt shingle installation and standing seam metal roofing for homes.

services.name: Commercial roofing
services.blurb: Roofing installation and repair for commercial properties.

services.name: Siding, fascia and soffit
services.blurb: Siding inspection, repair and replacement, including fascia and soffit.

services.name: Gutters
services.blurb: Gutter and downspout replacement and repair, including storm damage.

services.name: Skylights and windows
services.blurb: Skylight installation and repair, and window replacement.

why_lead: Three things customers mention again and again.

why.title: They show up when they say they will
why.text: Reviewers say Harriss calls when promised, arrives when promised and finishes fast, even after storm damage.

why.title: Quality work at a fair price
why.text: Customers describe the work as impeccable and the pricing as reasonable, and come back for later jobs.

why.title: A family team that explains the work
why.text: Reviews mention photos of what was repaired, a knowledgeable Harriss family and an accommodating office.

reviews.text: If only other companies could emulate what Harriss Roofing does: they call when they say they will, arrive when they say they will, and do the job (even better) than they say they will. The quality of the work is impeccable; the costs are very reasonable … 5 stars without hesitation!
reviews.author: Debbie Hughes

reviews.text: I'm very pleased with the excellent quality of work and fair pricing we've received from Harriss Roofing. Over the past 3 years, they have installed a standing seam metal roof on a new addition, repaired storm damage to our rain gutters, and inspected and repaired our siding. The Harriss family/team has been very knowledgeable and supportive …
reviews.author: Paul Musante

reviews.text: Had a large branch come down and damaged the roof. Harriss fixed the problem very fast, highly recommend. Have used them several times in the past, and always had excellent results
reviews.author: Donald Graney

area_lead: Based in Glen Burnie, serving Anne Arundel County and the surrounding area.
